plan.root_cause: The header component sets aria-hidden="true" on the navigation menu on desktop because it initializes based solely on the absence of the 'govuk-header__navigation--open' class, without considering that the menu button is hidden via CSS and the navigation is visibly displayed. This hides the navigation links from assistive technology.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the header component's init method to detect whether the menu button is visible (mobile view). If the button is hidden (desktop), treat the navigation as permanently visible and set aria-hidden="false". Only add the click listener when the button is visible.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: The navigation links will be exposed as links in the accessibility tree on desktop, allowing keyboard and screen reader users to reach and activate them.
functional_risks: Minimal; the change only affects desktop where the menu button is hidden. Mobile toggle behavior unchanged.
Potential risk if getComputedStyle forces layout, but it's a one-time check on init.
verification_requirements: Run the existing journey test; ensure ax assertions for "Apply", "Renew a licence", "Fishing rules" pass.
Verify mobile toggle still works (manual check).

plan.root_cause: The header component initializes aria-expanded based solely on the presence of 'govuk-header__navigation--open' class, but on desktop the navigation is visibly displayed without this class (the menu button is hidden via CSS). This causes aria-expanded='true' and aria-hidden='false' incorrectly, hiding navigation links from assistive technology.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify Header.prototype.init to detect desktop vs mobile by checking if the menu button is visible (getComputedStyle display !== 'none'). On desktop (button hidden), set aria-expanded='false' and aria-hidden='false' directly and skip click listener. On mobile, use existing logic with '--open' class and add click listener.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: On desktop, the navigation links are exposed as links in the accessibility tree with aria-hidden='false', and the menu button has aria-expanded='false'. Keyboard and screen reader users can reach and activate all navigation links. Mobile toggle behavior unchanged.
functional_risks: Minimal; change only affects desktop initialization where button is hidden. Mobile toggle behavior unchanged.
getComputedStyle may force layout but only runs once on init.
verification_requirements: Run the existing journey test; ensure ax assertions for "Apply", "Renew a licence", "Fishing rules" pass.
Verify mobile toggle still works (manual check).
Confirm aria-expanded='false' and aria-hidden='false' on desktop.
